lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Commander, commander!!

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I just messed with the A.C.P.U.!
With Poli?
With Miranda?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: No, I said I messed with the A.C.P.U.
Poli and Miranda are the only two members of the A.C.P.U.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Whatever.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I was hanging out in the gutters today,

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: when the A.C.P.U. started harassing me.
What were you doing in the gutter?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Finding stuff to chew on.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: There was this pipe made of reinforced plastic or something.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: It was super tough, but if I bit down hard on it,

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I could break it down into smaller pieces.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: It was awesome!

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Water started gushing out everywhere.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Made a heck of a lotta noise, too.
Sounds like you had fun.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: So there I was minding my own business, when the A.C.P.U. showed up.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: They ran over and started shouting at me,

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: so I stole their hats.
You what?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I stole their hats and ran off.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: They tried to chase after me, but I ran for a loooong time.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: They almost got me a couple times.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I used to hate those two,

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: but it was fun horsing around with them today.
What about their hats?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I'm wearing them right now.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Both of 'em.
... I can feel a migraine coming on.
You have to give them back.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Hmm???

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Why??

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: If I keep these, I'll be able to keep having fun with Miranda and Poli.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I hope they come to hang out with me soon.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: In the meantime, do you want to hang out, Commander?
Jackal, give them back.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Why do you keep pestering me about the hats?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Don't you like me having a fun time with the A.C.P.U.?
No, I don't.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Why not??!!

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Don't you want me to be happy!??!!?
I want you all to myself.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Huh???

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Ah-hah!

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I knew it!!!

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Are you jealous????
Yes.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Heh-heh.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Gotcha. I'll be right back once I return these.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: But in return,

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I want you to do me a favor.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I want you to...

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: run your fingers through my hair 100 times!
Only 100 times? That's easy.

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: All right!

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: I'll be back soon.
... I may have to apologize to Poli and Miranda next time I see them.
